title.en: Which printed window fits this check: this is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline — Electric 40. The aggregate-13 cell is 40 m horizontal / 120 m vertical, shorter than the fine-stone cell on the same page.
title.zh: 这一问只对一个窗口：这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑：电动40。13 骨料格是水平 40 m / 垂直 120 m，比同一页的细石格短。

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Read it in the Xingtai table. The aggregate-13 cell is 40 m horizontal / 120 m vertical, shorter than the fine-stone cell on the same page. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists Electric 40 at 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine stone 120 m / 360 m, aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 112, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 2300 kg. Keep this cell as published. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 30, which prints 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, fine stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m, maximum aggregate ≤ 3 cm, hopper 0.3 m³, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. Read it in the Xingtai table. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This note names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑。13 骨料格是水平 40 m / 垂直 120 m，比同一页的细石格短。邢台河北品锦机械把电动40列为45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13 骨料 40 m / 120 m、料斗 0.4 m³、川崎 112、外形 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、2300 kg。不要把同一工况挪到电动30，那一行印的是30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 60 m / 180 m、13 骨料 20 m / 60 m、最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm、料斗 0.3 m³、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
